talas.t: Still awake. Shoeing one of the mares at 7, the farrier is late again
Up. Frost on the potato rows, the field is white 🥔❄️
Talas clear this morning, minus 4 in my street. Scraped the car for 10 min
Kayırluu tañ! Is the 14 bus running? Trying to get to the lesson by 8
Kayırluu tañ. Yes so far, the Trans-Talas lane is open again. Marshrutka 38 to Nurzhan if you want it faster
Rahmat! Going bus 14 then, I like the seat by the window 🙂
Kids at kindergarten have colds again. Don't come in if you're coughing please 🙏
Salam. Counter opens at 9. Anyone's old Nokia still charging? Nobody brings those in anymore lol
Rustam ask Bakyt he still has one in his truck 😂
It's in the glovebox, works, 2 years of battery left maybe
Nurzhan 177 on the air app this morning. Nobody should be jogging there today
Talas is 119 on that same app. Still bad for kids. Keep the windows shut and dampen the stove 🙏
Iyık Janyl 144 and it's fog there too, they said inversion till noon
Bazar changers at 11.45 buy, 12.00 sell for dollars this morning. Euro 12.55 / 13.15
Tellers got the same sheet. Nobody is buying dollars, everyone is asking about euros 😅
My son wants to go to Germany next year, he asks me every day what 1 euro is in som. 9.25 official right? 😩
Official cross is 9.25 yes. Changers always take their cut, tell him to shop around
Old City is white on the top again. Lovely 🏔️
Hippodrome board says Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr on the 21st, 19:00 at the State Hippodrome. Round 11 of the ulak. I'll bring the grey
Kyzyl-Adyr is clear and -2 at night, not a bad day for their trip
Anyone know a good 1-room in Talas? I'm paying 1,500 for a shoebox near the Philharmonic, that's the top of the range I hear
Top end yes. Near the station you can find 1,000. Ask in the marshrutka group, people post flats there
Potatoes at the bazar, 2.10 a kilo now. Last week it was 2 in the inner rows, prices creep up with the cold
Jakshı. I'll buy a sack for the kindergarten kitchen then
Heating is on everywhere now. My radiator clanks like a horse in the night lol
Mine doesn't warm the kitchen at all. Blanket and kettle 🫖
Who is coming Thursday? Tündük 18:30, I need someone to talk about weather with, my students only want to talk about phones
Me! Practising the word for inversion. Temperature inversion is 'harmu' or 'tumanı', right?
Tumanı is the one everyone uses. Good, you're ready 👍
[sticker: haha]
Toktogul reservoir is 83% full and dropping, 15.82 of 19 km³. Water year looks ok but the dam guys are not relaxed
Drawing down 51 million m³ in one day, is that normal for November?
Winter releases, yes. Just means the electricity sellers are busy 😄
Tyre shop, first customer of the day brought a car with summer tyres on the Fergana road. Winter tyres or chains, people, the pass is cold 🚗
The Ala-Bel gateway is open with chains. Suusamyr and Otmek are closed for winter, don't try it
[poll: Thursday Tündük exchange: are you coming?] yes / no / after lesson
Ooh, a poll, you're all very organised today 😂
Anyone at Attelkom internet? The lines are down again in the north part of Talas, Tulpar works though
Same here near the station. Smartphone data ok, wifi keeps dropping
Lunch. Chicken plov at the bank canteen, 28 som a plate. Not bad today 🍚
Plov at 28 is the same as always, what's special about today?
It was actually hot. Stop being negative 😤
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar are 22 a kilo this week. Cheap for a walnut year, my cousin is buying a sack
22 for walnuts, my grandchildren eat them like sweets, I'll get them a bag
Liberty Boulevard parade is done, nothing like the wind orchestra this time, just a bus 😂
You mean the Swiss band? Did they actually come?
Ha, I meant the bus stop lol. No Swiss, sorry Rustam
Any news on the Jibek Jolu fire report? Still waiting, aunt is selling from home
Nothing yet. Court adjourned until the report comes. Hang in there Nurbek
Rahmat. Every week the same answer
The Herald has a headline: Turkish-Qatari group won the Bukhara terminal deal, 23 years. Talas has no partner like that. Who cares, I want a Bukhara trip
It's the Herald, they write the big ones. Our airport will still be at the end of the queue lol
Bukhara trip is a good idea though. Tickets?
Bus from Talas is 45 to Iyık Janyl first, then more. Long way. I'll stay with my horses 🐎
Anyone watching the Ulak Tartysh sheets? Chu 6-3 Sary-Bulak on the 14th, Talas 2-3 Dastgoh. We're second in ISEZ now? No, third?
Elnur again. ISEZ: Chu top on 26, Talas 22 second. Dastgoh and Iyık Janyl on 16 both
Right, Talas second. Dastgoh lost to us? No, they beat us 3-2 🙃
[sticker: kosh]
Tulpar has 62 now, Neftchi on 63. One point. Last round is done, so that's the league 😤
Dang. Last day was 2-1 to Neftchi, I watched it on my phone at the counter
Neftchi are champions. Irad Cup final is on the 7th, Neftchi v Attelkom, that's over too
Bah. Season ticket money well spent anyway 🙂
Women's League: Tulpar first on 23, Universitet 22. Congrats to the girls
Women's side finished strong, Universitet won their last one 3-2 vs Iyık Janyl. Teachers are proud 😂
Sat 12 Dec, play-off semi-finals at the Hippodrome. ISEZ place 1 v Highland place 2 at 19:00, the second one at 21:00. Horse people go to the second, I'm told
Good people stay late, I've heard that somewhere 😄
[sticker: horse_love]
Dinner. Tea and bread at home, nan from the bazar is 3.50 a loaf and still the best 🍞
Anyone else's power blink this evening? Lights went down for a sec on Ak-Suu street
Normal supply in Talas per the outage page. Maybe your neighbours' heater 😅
Power is fine in the villages too. Our side has been stable all week
Heating bill arrived. Coal and firewood are the real cost this winter, not the power
Coal is the thing. Half my salary goes to the stove 😩
Thinking of moving to Iyık Janyl. A 1-room is 600 to 1,000 there. Air is 144 though, same as the fog
Clean air is worth a lot. Ask around, the Iyık Janyl people are friendly 🙂
Iyık Janyl has fog and inversion tonight, bring a mask to the walk 😷
Round 11 of ISEZ is Sat 21st. Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr at 19:00, Hippodrome. Who's going? Elnur's cousin is playing 😄
Elnur, your cousin again. Sure, I'll come to see the ulak
I'll come, first match in Talas for me 🐎
[sticker: tlpr_up]
Tulpar Talas ticket for Sat 12 Dec, did anyone see the price? Season ticket covers it
Season holders in, others at the gate. Don't ask me the number
Kids asleep, finally. Night tea and a book 📖
Quiet night in the Old City, fog coming down the hill. Who's still up? 🌫️
Me. Waiting for the Jibek Jolu report, lol. Still nothing
Nurbek, same. Tomorrow at the exchange booth, pass the word if you hear
Writing my Iradi for Thursday. Tumanı, harmu, all of it 😅
Early shift tomorrow. Night Talas 🌙
Night. Potatoes at 5 again 🥔
[sticker: salam]
Night all, rahmat for the chat 🍵
Night Talas. Let's hope the inversion lifts. Kayırluu tañ
Night. Cash count at 6 again 🙃
Night 🌙 Kids will be up at 6 anyway
Can't sleep. Inversion sitting on the Trans-Talas like a lid 😮‍💨
Same. Window is steamed up from the inside
Kayırluu tañ. Fog still in the Old City, can't see the Philharmonic from my window
Kayırluu tañ. Frost on the potato rows already. Minus 6 at the kitchen door
Kids are up at 6:30 as usual. Who has a spare pair of mittens? One of mine lost his again
Check the lost and found box at school 9, they always have a pile
Kayırluu tañ! 14 bus was on time this morning 🎉
Wow. Someone tell the driver
Morning all. Ran the counter with my hands in my pockets, the shop heater is still off till 9
Ask the landlord. Ours came on at 7:10 after two calls 🙄
PM2.5 says 37.5 here per the air page. Not great, not Nurzhan either
Air 106 in Talas. The kids will wear masks to the walk to school today, my rule 😷
Nurzhan is 196 though. Rustam how is your lungs over there now
Coughing less since I came. Miss the plov at Dastarkhan though 😅
Potatoes in Bazar-i Kalan? Bakyt you still got cheap ones?
Potatoes at 2.10 per kilo wholesale now. The sack price holds but nobody buys sacks in November
Buying 2 sacks for the kindergarten kitchen. 2.10 is fine
Hay for my two is 26 a bale in the valleys. My supplier says it is going up after the snow
Every year they say that lol
Heard the Tulparcoin was at 3.18 cents this noon, down 5.5%. Not my money thankfully 😬
Nobody at my booth wants to touch it. Coin name case stays until next year anyway
Court wants the Bank of Irad to give its opinion first. Could take forever
Tulpar fans still singing though 🔴⚪
Anyone checked the Fergana road this morning? Chains needed to Ala-Bel?
Chains or winter tyres required, it said on the board. Suusamyr is closed anyway so don't even try that way
Put the tyres on the shop lift today, half my customers are on the Trans-Talas wanting winter sets 🛞
Reminder: Thursday 18:30 English/Iradi exchange at the Tündük café is tonight! Boorsok is on me this week 🥟
Tonight already? I was writing my Iradi on Wednesday lol. Tumanı, harmu, tañ 😅
Perfect, you're ready. Say 'kayırluu tañ' and people will forgive you the rest
[poll: Who is going to the Tündük exchange tonight?]
Lunch by the Tündük, anyone? I have 40 minutes
Busy, the exchange booth stays open. Next week maybe
Round 11 Sat 21st, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00 at the Hippodrome. I already got my season pass for that one 😎
My cousin says the ulak pitch got new cloth. Better than last year
Ulak is the real game. Horses on the Hippodrome, not football bodies lol
Still going, bringing the scarf 🐎
Lunch done. Pipes in the booth froze overnight, tea was not hot
Hot tea helps. Kids took their lunch in the classroom, the radiator is finally warm 🫖
Radiator on our side is cold, we use the coal stove still. Diesel for the tractor is 6.10 now btw, fine for the moment
Diesel 6.10 at the Trans-Talas station. Petrol 95 is 5.85
Tractor fuel is what kills a tyre shop in winter lol, nobody drives far
[sticker: haha]
Anyone know a 1-room in Talas near the TSU? Budget 1,000 to 1,500 a month
Ask at the TSU board, the ones on the second floor. Some are 1,000 flat, most 1,200 to 1,500
Rahmat! Getting cold feet about rent after Nurzhan prices 😅
Iyık Janyl is 600 to 1,000 if you don't mind the fog
Fog 8 degrees high today there, you'd get the sun. Nurbek you'd be closer to the air bad though
Old Jibek Jolu market news? Nurbek any word from the fire service?
Nothing yet. Aunt is still at home. Thanks for asking 🙏
Sending her some of my potatoes, 2.10 a kilo is nothing 🥔
Kazakh som dropped again. Changers at Bazar-i Kalan: USD 11.55 buy, 11.90 sell. Taking the euro too: 12.50 / 13.10
Official is 8.40 since 2008 lol. Nobody uses it
Our apples in Chu are 3.45 a kilo now. Good for the jam, bad for the gardens lol
Walnuts at Toktogul bazar 22 a kilo, my sister says the nuts came late
Who is coming to the Tündük tonight? Need to know how many boorsok to fry 😅
Me! 18:30 sharp, I will try the new Iradi words on everybody
I'll come after the kids are in bed, around 19:00 if that's ok
Of course! 🙂
Hippodrome stables are cold tonight. Bringing a second blanket for the grey mare
Horses are tougher than us. Only the people complain
Power is fine in Talas still? Our booth lights blinked twice this afternoon
Outage page says normal supply in Talas, Nurzhan and Iyık Janyl. No cuts scheduled. Probably your neighbours' heater again 😅
Tulpar works fine, but everything else in Nurzhan crawls. Next week I'm moving out of there lol
Nurbek, you are the only one who says that about the internet 😂
Here at the Tündük! Salam all 👋
Salam Rustam! Boorsok is hot, sit down
Salam, did I miss the start? I'll sit by Rustam, he owes me an English lesson
Kayırluu kech 😂 Tañ... tuura... kech
Close! Kech kayırluu. Excellent, Rustam
[sticker: salam]
Coming in late, the booth had a queue of 30. Save me a boorsok 🥟
Saved! Cold tea too, the heater here is broken lol
Anyone watched the Irad Cup final result? Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom on the 7th, that's old news now lol. Ready for Round 11
Old news yes. Neftchi won the league too, we had 62, they had 63 😭
One point. One point! Next season we get them 🔴⚪
Ok, one point, I heard Tulpar lost to Neftchi 2–1 on the last day. Is that right?
Yes, 2–1 at Nurzhan on 31 Oct. Bad day
Round 11 for ulak Sat 21st: Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00 at the Hippodrome, Elnur's cousin plays. Bringing the kids?
Maybe. Tell them to bring their gloves, it's the cold part of the season 🧤
Rustam, one more: how do you say 'the frost came early' in Iradi?
Erte sook tüştü? Am I right?
Almost perfect! Erte suuk tüştü. Well done 👏
Sending the photo of my sack of potatoes in the cellar. Not bad for November 🥔
Nice! Kids want to see the Bars photo too haha
Inversion over Talas tonight, fog low on the Old City. PM2.5 37.5 they say, not terrible
Put on a mask at the Tündük if you go to the bazar tomorrow 😷
Tulpar Talas ticket for Sat 12 Dec, price on the box office page? Season holders are fine
Season holders in, others at the gate. Same as before lol
Fixed a Samsung screen at the counter today. Customer cried with joy 😂
Ha! Rustam the hero of Talas 📱
Still no word on the Jibek Jolu report. Going to bed, Begaiym tell me if you hear
Will do. Tomorrow at the booth
Kids asleep. Night tea and a book 📖
Night all, rahmat for the chat 🍵
Night. Potatoes at 5 again 🥔
[sticker: salam]
Night Talas. Let's hope the inversion lifts. Kayırluu tañ
Night. Cash count at 6 again 🙃
Early shift tomorrow too. Night 🌙
Night all. Thank you for the boorsok and the Iradi lesson 🙏
Night 🌙 Kids will be up at 6 anyway
Can't sleep, the radiator in the flat is banging like someone is inside it
Kayırluu tañ. Fog on the Old City road again, can't see the poplars
Morning! Cash count at 6, my eyes are still closed 🙃
Check the airport board before you go anywhere today. Fog at Talas Airport, flights held till about 10:35
Rahmat Elnur. Good thing I have no flight, I'm taking the 14 bus to school
Air quality says unhealthy for sensitive groups in Talas today. Kids with the cough, keep the windows shut 😷
Mask again then. Tyre shop smells of rubber and smoke, nothing new
Salam all. Anyone know if the Tündük kiosk opens before 8? Need a new charger cable
Kiosk opens 8. Ask for Tolgonai, she has cables in the drawer by the window
Rahmat! Adding that to my list of Talas secrets 😄
Potatoes in the cellar are fine. Wrapped them in newspaper like my father did
Tulpar Talas ticket for 12 Dec: is anyone going with a kid? Asking for the family rate
Kids under 7 go free at the gate I think. Check at the box office before you queue
Jakshı. Kids love the Hippodrome anyway, the horses are the highlight
Still on the Jibek Jolu report. Begaiym any news from the booth?
Nothing yet. Traders at the booth asking the same thing 😕
Tonight is the Thursday exchange no wait, it was yesterday! Missed it, I'm so tired 😅
Next week then. I'll bring the boorsok this time, promise
Hippodrome stables: the hay is in, 26 som a bale in the valleys so they say. Our two are happy
Hay at 26 a bale, and I'm still paying for the boots 🥾
Heard the Kyrgyz 2027 draft has 105bn som for schools. Talas chapter still not out. Anyone?
My school has 3 tables with the same broken chair. Hope the chapter comes soon
Last year they promised the same. Till the chapter is out I will believe nothing 😒
Ha, Marat with the kalpak. Are the Hippodrome people selling tickets for Saturday?
Ulak Round 11 Sat at the Hippodrome, Talas v Kyzyl-Adyr 19:00. Gates open at 18:30
We're going! Elnur, your cousin is playing?
Yes, he is on the left wing. Hope the Kyzyl-Adyr boys don't break his nose again 😂
Lunch at the nan stall: bread still 3.50 a loaf. Same as always
Rates at the booth this morning, USD 11.55 buy and 11.95 sell. Euro 12.50/13.10. Come before 2pm, after that the queue is long
So the changers are way above the bank 8.40. Who is making money here 😅
Not me, I just count it 🙃
Bank counter has been jammed since 11, everyone wants to change for the Kazakh trip
Good for the tyre shop, every second car on the Trans-Talas has a flat in this cold
Ilbirs station filmed three snow leopards on a Chatkal slope! Who has seen them?
Snow leopard? Me, never. Only tracks in the snow near my cousin's sheep pen 2 years ago
Kids will ask about this for a week. Send me the clip if it's public 🐆
Waste pact with the Swiss in Talas Oblast, valley districts are still weighing their tips. Who sorts the bins at your block?
Nobody in my block. The bins fill up and then someone takes them. Mystery
Did anyone see the Herald piece on the orchard coin? Bank of Irad hasn't said how many they minted
Ask the bank, not us 😂 Some people already bought it to keep
Apples in Chu are 3.45 a kilo now, my sister says the Chu ones are better than the Talas ones 🍎
Your sister is wrong, Chu apples are small. Bring me a sack of the Talas Antonovka
Tell your sisters the walnuts from Toktogul are 22 a kilo, that's the good ones 🌰
22 for walnuts. My aunt used to send them from Toktogul for free 😢
Pour some tea, Nurbek. Your aunt will sell again when the report comes
Customer brought a phone with the back cracked and asked me to fix the camera. Charged 1 on the back, cracked no more
Lol, fair. Rustam you are becoming a real Talas man 😄
Kids home. Who is making plov tonight? I have rice and no time 😩
Plov at 28 a plate in the Tündük, not bad. Beats your kitchen 😂
Bakyt you are a terrible cook and a worse guest 😂
Night shift cover tomorrow, anyone? I'm off by 15:00
I can do the morning if you take 13:00 to 17:00 Sunday
Deal. Rahmat Begaiym 🙏
Chatkal road is closed until spring but the Trans-Talas is ok. Driver said the Otmek is closed for the winter anyway
Trying to get to Nurzhan on Sunday. Marshrutka 38 or bus 32? Which is less cold
Bus 32, the marshrutka driver always stops for 20 minutes at the Kara-Bulak turn
Rahmat. Bus it is 🚌
Ok the Attelkom internet is still slow, Tulpar works fine though. Anyone else?
Works fine at the tyre shop. Yesterday everything was slow, today ok
Kids asleep at 19:50 for once! Miracle 😴
Inversion again, fog on the Old City. The air is heavy 😷
Irad Cup final is Sat 7 Nov, Neftchi 2–0 Attelkom. Still hurts. Tulpar was better in the league anyway
Tulpar finished second on 62, one point behind Neftchi. Don't start 🙃
Bad day at the Nurzhan ground, I'm not talking about it 😤
Ulak Round 10 in ISEZ: Talas 2–3 Dastgoh, Iyık Janyl 5–4 Nurzhan. Anyone there?
Talas lost to Dastgoh by one. Our horses saw the whole game, they were not impressed
Talas is 2nd in ISEZ on 22, Chu top on 26. Hippodrome on Saturday, we can still get the top
Jakshı attitude! We'll be in the stands with the kids and the thermos 🍵
Anyone know a 1-room flat in Talas for under 1,500 som? I'm sick of the room at the back of the repair shop
Talas 1-room at 1,000 to 1,500 a month. Ask the agent by the Tündük, he is honest-ish 😅
Honest-ish is the best Talas can offer 😂 rahmat
Coal delivery came, 4 tonnes for the winter. Pay in the morning, no discount. Typical
Our radiators are finally warm. Tell me this is not a dream
Night all, Rustam, Begaiym rahmat. Erte suuk tüştü, dress warm 🧣
Erte suuk tüştü, Aizada. Got it 😄 Night!
[sticker: salam]
Night Talas. Mask on tomorrow if you go to the bazar. Kayırluu tañ
Night. Early shift Sunday 🌙
Night. Potatoes at 5 again 🥔
Night all. Cash count at 6, I'm going to dream of dollars 💵
Night 🌙 Kids will be up at 6 anyway

nurzhan.t: Не спится. Ночная смена по радио, туман до окна
Доброе утро, Нуржан! Туман такой, что соседний дом не видно 😶
Доброе. Дочь в школу на Навбахоре пошла в маске, сказали, так надо
Инверсия сегодня стоит на весь день. AQI по городу 177, это уже плохо для всех
Игорь, ты как метеоцентр 🙂 У меня уже в аптеке очередь за ингалятором
Цех говорит, на второй смене дышать нечем. Окна не открывать, понятно
Доброе! Вы про коины слышали? Сегодня с Игорем начинаем чистку, никому пока не говорите 🙃
Дилноза, у нас в лаборатории стены уже слышат 😄
Morning! Tea at 9? 🍵
Айгерим, я только с ночи, но чай бы не отказался
Нурзhan, на Дастгохе опять вода с утра тонко. Ведро наберите на всякий
Да, у нас тоже. Громкоговоритель молчит, как обычно
Is the air like this every day here? In Talas it was better today, 119 🙁
Талас чище, там ветер с гор. Здесь котельные дымят, и инверсия прижимает всё вниз
Айгерим, на Нуржане в ноябре так почти всегда. Зимой полегче станет, когда ветер поменяется
В Иык-Жаныле сейчас 144, в Таласе 119. Почти вся осень такая
Бензин AI-92 сейчас 5.40, а дизель 6.10. Вчера на заправке очередь была
За дизель уже не радуюсь. У брата в Кара-Буре на районе 8.55 и выше, это в горах
Это Чаткал, там всё дороже. Нам тут везут нормально
Игорь, сходим в столовую? Там сегодня плов обещали, 28 сом порция, для студентов дёшево
Плов в Политехе на 28 — это уже подвиг. Идём, по дороге поговорим про коины 🙃
Who knows where to buy good nan near Dastgoh? The one by my house is always gone by 9
Айгерим, на Дастгохе хороший нан у рынка возле третьих ворот, пекут рано. Там же хлеб 3.50 буханка
Rahmat, Svetlana! I will go early tomorrow 🙂
Кто-нибудь ходил на ярмарку сушёных яблок? Айгерим, а твои из Таласа где брала?
From my aunt in Talas, she sells at Talas bazar. Apples in Chu are 3.45 per kg now, she says cheap this year 🍎
Айгерим, а ореехи где берёте? В Токтогуле грецкий 22 за кило, это дорого
Walnuts from Toktogul are good, but expensive. We buy in bulk in autumn 🙂
Ребят, Тулпар Талас в Женской лиге выиграл 23 очка, Университет 22. Бабы рвут 💪
Андрей, не подкалывай, Университет тоже молодцы 🙂
Женская лига последний тур: Аттелком проиграл Нуржану 0:3, это они не ожидали
Нуржан в женской, это кто? Ах, Нефтяник... да, 0:3 звучит больно
Мы в лаборатории все ещё ждём, когда пройдёт формальная передача коинов. Музей тянет
Тянут, да. Университет хочет сначала опубликовать, а музей требует сразу. Мы в середине
Вы там не ссорьтесь из-за монет 😄 Шесть тысяч лет истории в одном ящике
Шесть тысяч? Караханидов там лет девятьсот, Светлана, это же не Ур 😅
Ой, я перепутала. Ладно, пусть будет девятьсот, историчка из меня плохая 🙃
Is it true the Turkish-Qatari company got the Bukhara terminal deal for 23 years? Talas has nobody like that 🙁
Айгерим, это Гулистан-Бухара, нам-то что. Но Талас как всегда без партнёров
Газовые терминалы у них, а у нас только трубы с Чатkала 🙄
Ребят, маршрутка Нуржан–Талас сейчас 38? Ещё в субботу поеду
38 и есть. После семи только частники, просят 60, так что лучше раньше
Понял, спасибо 🙏
Тоқтогул сейчас 83.2%, и вода опускается на 51 миллион кубов в сутки. Лето было жарким, дождей почти не было
Игорь, опять сводка 🙂 А свет-то хоть не отключат?
По энергии норма, плановых отключений нет. Экспорт в Узбекистан и Казахстан по графику
Футбол в субботу: Нефтчи уже чемпион, а Тулпар и Дастгох... Айбек, не начинай 😄
Нефтчи чемпион, поздравляю себя. 1 очко от Тулпара, два тура назад было 4
Андрей, ты сказал 4 очка, а таблица такая: 63 и 62. Отрыв один 🙃
Ну, был отрыв четыре очка. Теперь один. Вот и всё
Кубок Ирада в субботу 7 ноября уже был, финал Нефтчи 2:0 Аттелкому. Поздравляю
Sorry, I missed the cup final. Neftchi 2-0 Attelkom, right? 🙂
Айгерим, да, 2:0. Ты у нас тоже болельщица? 😄
A little! My brother plays for Talas youth, so I watch Tulpar 🙂
